neighbours.label: a sentence-initial one-word discourse connective that continues an argument ('Moreover', 'Furthermore', 'However'); the same sentence opened by 'In addition', 'Then' or no connective stays low
fire: The museum lost its main sponsor last year. Moreover, visitor numbers fell sharply.
The road is narrow and badly lit. Furthermore, there is no pavement for walkers.
The plan looked cheap on paper. However, the final bill was twice the estimate.
Our results agree with earlier surveys. Moreover, they hold across all age groups.
The drug lowered blood pressure in most patients. Furthermore, it had few side effects.
The village seemed quiet at first. However, the market drew crowds every weekend.
The contract was signed in haste. Moreover, nobody had read the final page.
The engine is efficient at low speeds. Furthermore, it runs on several fuels.
quiet: The museum lost its main sponsor last year. In addition, visitor numbers fell sharply.
The road is narrow and badly lit. There is no pavement for walkers either.
The plan looked cheap on paper. Then the final bill arrived at twice the estimate.
Our results agree with earlier surveys. They hold across all age groups.
The drug lowered blood pressure in most patients. In addition, it had few side effects.
The village seemed quiet at first. Then the market drew crowds every weekend.
The contract was signed in haste. Nobody had read the final page.
The engine is efficient at low speeds. In addition, it runs on several fuels.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.6 on ' Moreover'/' Furthermore'/' However'; 'In addition', 'Then' and bare openings below 0.12
notes: Card peaks ' Moreover' x15, ' However' x7, ' Furthermore' x3, all after a full stop. Probe on one frame: Moreover 0.518, Furthermore 0.454, However 0.417, Also 0.289; 'In addition,' 0.036, 'Then' 0.102, no connective 0.011, mid-sentence 'and, moreover,' 0.151. Near misses avoid 'Also'.
